context_requirements: Presence of thyroid hormone response elements in accessible chromatin
Cellular context permissive for thyroid hormone signaling (e.g., hepatic or neuronal lineage)
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of canonical thyroid hormone target genes (e.g., DIO1, KLF9, THRB) at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are absent in vehicle controls and consistent across replicates
Evidence of THRA/THRB pathway activation by gene expression signature enrichment
